## WHATSAPP A) SEND  (POST /webhook/client-hunter-wa-send)
ONE lead + ONE number per request (lists / bulk payloads are rejected).
1) Look up the lead's own row (by Lead_ID): already Sent/Delivered/Read, Pending, Unconfirmed or Sending -> NOTHING is sent, the stored status is returned. Only an explicit `resend: true` from the interface (after a confirm box) sends again.
2) Row saved as `Sending` (name + number)  3) WAHA session + number check  4) WAHA `POST /api/sendText`  5) message id saved in `Run_ID`.
If the sheet cannot be written, NOTHING is sent.
**WAHA URL:** change it ONLY in the `WAHA Config` node (tunnel URLs change when the tunnel restarts).
**API KEY:** Header Auth credential, header name `X-Api-Key` (selected on the 3 WAHA HTTP nodes). Never paste the key in the JSON.
**ACCESS CODES** are in `Prepare WA` and `Parse WA Status` (same as the other workflows).
**SHEET:** `WhatsApp` tab: Lead_ID, Business_Name, WhatsApp_Number, Status, Message, Run_ID, Saved_At, Updated_At, Error

## WAHA CONFIG (change here only)
`waha_base_url` = current WAHA URL (Cloudflare tunnel), no trailing slash needed.
`waha_session` = `default`.
When the quick tunnel restarts you get a new URL: paste it here and save.

## WHATSAPP B) STATUS  (POST /webhook/client-hunter-wa-status)
READ-ONLY. Looks up one lead's own row by `lead_id` (`run_id` is optional). It never calls WAHA and never sends or resends anything.
Replies with the stored status: Not sent / Sending / Pending / Sent / Delivered / Read / Failed / Unconfirmed. The ack lane below updates the row.

## WHATSAPP C) DELIVERY ACK  (POST /webhook/waha-message-ack)
WAHA calls this URL for every `message.ack` event (1 = sent, 2 = delivered, 3 = read, 4 = played, -1 = error). The row is found by `Run_ID` and updated only when the new status is newer.
**Production URL:** https://cuanhkuanhlong.app.n8n.cloud/webhook/waha-message-ack  (workflow must be Active)
**Security:** this webhook needs a Header Auth credential; WAHA sends the same header via `customHeaders`.
